mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.doc_id as docId, d.data_source_id as dataSourceId, d.channel, d.name, d.file_type as fileType, d.doc_type as docType, d.doc_type_name as docTypeName, d.source_name as sourceName, d.source_status as sourceStatus, d.switch_status as switchStatus, d.task_status as taskStatus, d.last_process_time as lastProcessTime, d.md5, d.file_size as fileSize, d.creator, d.create_time as createTime, d.modifier, d.update_time as updateTime, d.visibility, d.xsky_path as xskyPath, d.bucket_name as bucketName, d.bucket_path bucketPath, d.vector_enabled as vectorEnabled, d.vector_id as vectorId, d.metadata, d.parent_doc_name as parentDocName, d.is_attachment as isAttachment, dt.dataset_id as datasetId, d.status as status FROM document d JOIN doc_type dt ON d.doc_type = dt.code WHERE d.doc_id = #{docId}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document ( doc_id, data_source_id, channel, name, parent_doc_name, is_attachment, own_dataset_id, file_type, doc_type, doc_type_name, source_name, switch_status, task_status, last_process_time, md5, file_size, creator, modifier, visibility, xsky_path, bucket_name, bucket_path, vector_enabled, vector_id, metadata, create_time, update_time, status ) VALUES ( #{docId}, #{dataSourceId}, #{channel}, #{name}, #{parentDocName}, IFNULL(#{isAttachment}, 0), #{ownDatasetId}, #{fileType}, #{docType}, #{docTypeName}, #{sourceName}, #{switchStatus}, #{taskStatus}, #{lastProcessTime}, #{md5}, #{fileSize}, #{creator}, #{modifier}, #{visibility}, #{xskyPath}, #{bucketName}, #{bucketPath}, #{vectorEnabled}, #{vectorId}, #{metadata}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{status} )
